verified_facts.text: The hotel was founded by Eduard Sacher, son of the creator of the Original Sacher-Torte, and under Anna Sacher became a meeting place for nobility, artists and businessmen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Founded in 1876 by Eduard Sacher, the son of the creator of the Original Sacher-Torte, Hotel Sacher soon became the top address for Viennese high society. Under the renowned Anna Sacher, it evolved into a meeting place for nobility

verified_facts.text: Franz Sacher created the Original Sacher-Torte in 1832, and it is still handcrafted in 34 steps.
verified_facts.excerpt: The foundations of Sacher date back to 1832, when Franz Sacher created the Original Sacher-Torte. To this day, it is handcrafted in 34 steps

verified_facts.text: Since 1934 the hotel has been managed by the Gurtler family and is privately owned.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 1934, the hotel has been carefully managed by the Gürtler family – privately owned and committed to tradition, excellence and authenticity.

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites were designed by co-owner Alexandra Winkler with French designer Pierre-Yves Rochon.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooms and suites were designed by co-owner Alexandra Winkler in collaboration with internationally renowned French star designer Pierre-Yves Rochon.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Selected materials, marble bathrooms and elegant interiors combine classic Viennese character with modern comfort

verified_facts.text: Some rooms look onto Karntner Strasse, the Vienna State Opera or the Albertina Museum; others overlook the quiet Maysedergasse or the courtyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some of the Hotel Sacher Vienna rooms have views of the iconic Kärntner Straße, Vienna State Opera or the Albertina Museum. Others overlook the quiet Maysedergasse or the courtyard.

verified_facts.text: Each room has a complimentary minibar with non-alcoholic beverages.
verified_facts.excerpt: A complimentary minibar with non-alcoholic beverages

verified_facts.text: The Opera Penthouse Suite has a spacious terrace and views over Vienna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opera Penthouse Suite – with spacious terrace and views over Vienna

verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Vienna State Opera, the Albertina Museum and St. Stephen's Cathedral, with the main sights reachable on foot.
verified_facts.excerpt: just steps away from the world-famous Vienna State Opera, the Albertina Museum and the magnificent St. Stephen’s Cathedral. The finest sights of Vienna are easily accessible on foot.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within steps of Karlsplatz/Oper, a hub for U-Bahn lines U1 and U4.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are within steps of **Karlsplatz/Oper**, a major hub for **U-Bahn (subway) lines U1 and U4**.

verified_facts.text: Restaurant Rote Bar serves authentic Austrian cuisine with classic Viennese dishes made with seasonal and regional ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rote Bar: Our head chef serves authentic Austrian cuisine at the highest level, featuring classic Viennese dishes made with seasonal and regional ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Restaurant Grune Bar offers international haute cuisine with modern accents and regional influence, with set menus and a la carte.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grüne Bar: Offers a special experience of international haute cuisine with modern accents and regional influence. Both set menus and à la carte options are available.

verified_facts.text: Cafe Sacher Wien serves Original Sacher-Torte alongside Viennese coffees, apple and curd cheese strudel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alongside our coffees, we serve the Original Sacher-Torte, traditional Viennese apple and curd cheese strudel, as well as selected creations from the Sacher Patisserie.

verified_facts.text: At lunch and dinner Cafe Sacher Wien serves classic Viennese dishes such as Wiener Schnitzel, veal goulash and Original Sacher Sausages, plus vegetarian and vegan options.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy favourites such as Wiener Schnitzel, creamy veal goulash and Original Sacher Sausages, alongside lighter dishes and a selection of vegetarian and vegan options.

verified_facts.text: The Original Sacher-Torte is sold in various sizes at the in-house Sacher Shop, with worldwide shipping for online orders.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, the Original Sacher-Torte is available in various sizes at our in-house Sacher Shop. You will also find fine souvenirs and exclusive products there. Online orders with worldwide shipping are also available

verified_facts.text: The Sacher Boutique Spa has a hammam, sauna and fitness room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can also enjoy soothing moments in the hammam, sauna or modern fitness room.

verified_facts.text: Spa massages use premium oils from Ligne St. Barth.
verified_facts.excerpt: Deeply relaxing massages with premium oils from Ligne St. Barth

verified_facts.text: The hotel has no swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unfortunately, we don’t have a swimming pool on site.

verified_facts.text: The concierge service is available around the clock.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, our experienced concierge service is available around the clock

verified_facts.text: On request the hotel organizes horse-drawn carriage rides through the Old Town, Danube river cruises and customized city tours.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Horse-drawn carriage rides through the Old Town
- Danube river cruises
- Customized city tours

verified_facts.text: Private tours of the historic hotel can be arranged on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, we are happy to organize exclusive private tours of our property upon request

verified_facts.text: The Petit Sacher offer includes selected children's dishes in all the restaurants, and children have complimentary access to the breakfast buffet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, our “Petit Sacher” offer includes selected children’s dishes available in all our restaurants. Additionally, children have complimentary access to the breakfast buffet.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is generally not included in the room rate.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breakfast at Hotel Sacher Vienna is generally not included in the room rate

verified_facts.text: There is no formal dress code, but smart casual to elegant attire is recommended in Rote Bar and Grune Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is no formal dress code. However, we kindly ask guests to dress in a manner appropriate to the elegant atmosphere of our hotel. In our restaurants such as the Rote Bar and Grüne Bar, we recommend smart casual to elegant attire.

verified_facts.text: For the 150th anniversary, two Erwin Wurm sculptures stand at the hotel entrance until November 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: To mark the beginning of the anniversary year in March 2026, Hotel Sacher Vienna presents two sculptures by internationally renowned Austrian artist Erwin Wurm at the hotel entrance
